notes: NP_11 s5's accessories and gear as the sim reads them. Gear is cosmetic-forward: gloves, wraps, robes and mouthguards, each piece a look (its colour, its material) and at most one small passive - its kind's, never more than cap_pct (NP_11 s5: 3%), so a board's passive on the same key (Snap, Tight Guard, Iron Jaw, Sparkplug: 15-30%) always outweighs it. A fighter wears one piece of each kind in the accessory slots his rarity opens (NP_11 s4, C44: 1 / 2 / 3 / 3). The club keeps its gear in one locker; a piece bought twice is two copies. The sources: the HBP shop by circuit progress (the technique shop's three shelves), circuit prizes that arrive once with their flags, a blessed house's gift of its colours (one per house, the piece by the house's style), festival prizes for an Exhibition 2v2 won on the boardwalk, and signature gear - a named character's identity piece, his alone (untradeable: no other card wears it). The names, looks, prices and percentages are first drafts for the content lane; the house gifts are named by rule (the house's colours), never by a cultural object (NP_07 s9).
